In our Collection Services team you are responsible for a portfolio of customers and support us in providing a high-quality receivables management.

- Performing active reminding activities and documenting results in the system, you ensure compliance with the deadlines and guidelines.
- You also take care of dispute cases and ensure their timely clarification working together with sales and credit managers.

- Finally, you are the direct point of contact for our external customers and for different partners in the company.

- completed formal vocational training program in Business and Commerce or a comparable degree or certification
- ideally first professional experience in accounts receivable
- ideally knowledge and skills in working with SAP R/3 as well as good knowledge of MS Office
- fluent in English as well as French, additional European language skills are a plus
- high customer orientation and outstanding communication skills

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 35.000 - 39.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success as well as individual performance
- Location-independent work models with defined days of presence in Berlin and place of residence in Germany - here a first impression

- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Development discussions and programs so that you can reach your full potential
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Modern sustainable office building in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg with flexible working options, rooftop terrace and cafeteria for innovative and team-focused collaboration - get to know our location﻿

HOW TO REACH US

- Maximilian Mette (Talent Acquisition), maximilian.mette@basf.com, Tel.:+49 30 2005-56084 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team on.basf.com/contact

jobs.occupation: Experienced Insurance Manager (f/m/d) Liability / Financial Lines (Versicherungsprüfer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In close collaboration with your team, you will play a key role within the global insurance and risk management of Siemens Energy. Working closely with your team, brokers, and insurers, you will actively shape the placement of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs in the international insurance market, provide advisory support to business units on complex contracts, and manage challenging claims. Your daily responsibilities will integrate legal and insurance expertise, strategic business thinking, negotiation skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex issues.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for the design, placement, implementation, and management of corporate liability and financial lines insurance programs, including the development of insurance terms and coverage concepts, considering the needs and risk profile of our business units
* Advising and placing liability project insurance
* Primary contact for insurance-related questions regarding contract structures and active participation in contract negotiations worldwide
* Supporting business units in reporting and processing insurance claims, as well as analysing and evaluating insurance solutions. Independently handling complex claims, with a particular focus on operational, product, and environmental liability claims, and managing claims processes abroad
* First point of contact for senior management-related questions regarding insurance coverage for the board and management in accordance with German corporate law

What You Bring

* Several years of relevant professional experience in a comparable position or relevant industry experience, particularly in the placement of international insurance programs, contract commentary, and claims handling in international project business
* Fluent in German (C1/C2) and English (C1), both written and spoken. Additional language skills, such as Spanish, are desirable
* Analytical skills and a confident approach to complex issues, connecting legal, technical, and economic aspects into clear recommendations
* Confident in negotiations, high level of personal responsibility, structured working style, and enjoyment of proactive topic advancement
* Proficient in all common MS Office applications and generative AI, with an affinity for implementing digital processes

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments.

Corteco is an internationally leading supplier in the open automotive replacement parts market. As a subsidiary of the global Freudenberg Group, we supply over 26,000 articles in OEM quality. In seals and vibration control technology as well as cabin air filters, this makes the product range of an original equipment manufacturer available to independent workshops and replacement parts dealers as well. Corteco is represented with its own sales offices in over 15 countries. Through the Freudenberg Group, we reach customers in 60 countries around the world.

Pinerolo - (TO)
Corteco GmbH

Freudenberg Aftermarket (FAM) is a newly established Business Group bringing together aftermarket activities from across the Freudenberg Group into one focused global organization. This opportunity is open to talent based at either of our locations in Weinheim, Germany, or Pinerolo, Italy.
We are looking for a finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with accounting expertise, business acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset. In this role, you will help establish the financial reporting and accounting governance foundations that support a growing international business.

Financial Analyst Group Reporting, Consolidation & Accounting Governance (f/m/d)

Responsibilities

- Drive Financial Transparency: Ensure accurate, reliable, and timely financial reporting across the Business Group while supporting key management and corporate reporting requirements.
- Support Consolidation & Closing Activities: Contribute to monthly and quarterly consolidation processes, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with Group standards.
- Strengthen Accounting Governance: Coordinate key accounting topics across international entities and support the resolution of complex accounting and audit-related matters.
- Provide Meaningful Insights: Transform financial data into clear analyses and management information that support sound business decisions.
- Partner Across the Organization: Collaborate with Finance teams, Shared Services, auditors, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment and effective issue resolution.
- Drive Process Excellence: Identify opportunities to improve reporting, closing, and governance processes through standardization, digitalization, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

- University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Extensive years of experience in group reporting, consolidation, financial controlling, accounting governance, or corporate finance within an international environment.
- Strong knowledge of IFRS, consolidation principles, financial reporting, month-end closing, provisions, accruals, and balance sheet management.
- Proven ability to analyze complex financial topics, challenge assumptions, and deliver high-quality results with accuracy and ownership.
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills, combined with a solid understanding of business impact.
- Experience partnering across multiple entities, functions, and stakeholders in an international organization.
- Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, digitalization initiatives, and finance transformation projects.
- Strong command of Excel, financial systems, and reporting tools; experience with HFM/Hyperion, Power BI, SAP BI, or similar platforms is an advantage.
- Fluent English; German is an advantage.

Some of your Benefits

International Opportunities : Grow in your career through international exchange and global job opportunities.
Personal Development : We offer a variety of trainings to ensure you can develop in your career.
Sustainability & Social Commitment : We support social and sustainable projects and encourage employee involvement.
Diversity & Inclusion : We focus on providing an inclusive environment and recognize our diversity contributes to our success.
Cafeteria/ Canteen : We offer fresh food on-site, both hot and cold.

Disclaimer

The Freudenberg Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants and associates without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, protected military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Own regional IT service delivery performance, service quality, and operational excellence across all sites.
Provide functional leadership and coordination of IT Site Managers, ensuring alignment of priorities, governance, and reporting standards.
Lead regional escalation and problem-management activities, driving sustainable resolution of major and recurring service issues.
Monitor service performance, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and drive continuous enhancement of IT operations and support services.
Act as the primary operational interface between regional business leadership, IT Business Partners, Corporate IT teams, and external service providers.
Coordinate cross-site IT initiatives and ensure effective implementation of Corporate IT standards, processes, and governance requirements.
Support regional IT financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, and validation of IT-related expenditures.

- Several years of experience in IT operations, IT service management, or regional IT service delivery within an international enterprise environment.
- Proven expertise in service-performance management, operational escalation management, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
- Experience leading and coordinating geographically distributed IT teams and managing external IT service providers.
- Strong understanding of enterprise IT services, operational governance, IT financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and invoice validation.
- Solid knowledge of IT service management frameworks, preferably ITIL, and broad exposure to workplace, infrastructure, connectivity, cloud, and business application services.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to drive sustainable outcomes across business and IT functions.
- Fluency in English and willingness to travel within the assigned region.
